"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents removed, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = "".join(ch for ch in s if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
EOF
cat > textutil/truncate.py <<'EOF'
"""Text truncation for previews."""

ELLIPSIS = "..."


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - len(ELLIPSIS)
    if budget <= 0:
        return ELLIPSIS[:max(limit, 0)]
    # Find the last whitespace at or before the budget, so the cut falls
    # between words (a word ending exactly at the budget is kept).
    head = text[: budget + 1]
    cut = -1
    for i, ch in enumerate(head):
        if ch.isspace():
            cut = i
    if cut <= 0:
        # No full word fits; return just the ellipsis rather than a partial word.
        return ELLIPSIS
    return text[:cut].rstrip() + ELLIPSIS
EOF

"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents removed, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = "".join(ch for ch in s if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
